# Lab 06 hints

<details><summary>Hint 1 — A string is iterable but not a citation list</summary>

Check the outer type before applying set operations. Otherwise `"KB-A"` may be interpreted as individual characters.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 2 — Validate elements before hashing them</summary>

A nested list is unhashable. Confirm every element is a nonempty string before constructing a set.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 3 — Two set relationships</summary>

The set's size must equal the original list's size, and the set must be a subset of retrieved IDs. A separate check rejects an empty list.

</details>
